cd /workspace/dev && cat > prof.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import analyze, infer, genbig

stats = {}
def wrap(cls, name):
    orig = getattr(cls, name)
    def f(self, *a, **k):
        t0 = time.process_time()
        r = orig(self, *a, **k)
        dt = time.process_time() - t0
        st = stats.setdefault(name, [0, 0.0])
        st[0] += 1; st[1] += dt
        return r
    setattr(cls, name, f)

for n in ('_model', '_opt'):
    wrap(infer._Engine, n)

x = genbig.gen(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 4, 'wide')
t0 = time.process_time()
got = analyze.process_line(json.dumps(x, separators=(',', ':')).encode())
print('total %.2fs status=%s' % (time.process_time() - t0, got.get('status')))
for k, (c, t) in sorted(stats.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1][1]):
    print('%-8s calls=%4d time=%7.2fs avg=%.3fs' % (k, c, t, t / c))
PYEOF
